symptom: Opening an mxcli-built project in Studio Pro rewrote hundreds of units with identical content (462 in the reporter's), and every later mxcli edit flipped them back: diffs and merges carried reordered keys. mx check, build and Studio Pro itself accepted the order; only git saw it.
file: modelsdk/canon/keyorder.go (SortKeys, applied in canon.CompleteForStorage on the write path); modelsdk/mpr/writer_core.go carryIdentityFromRemovedUnit. Tests: modelsdk/canon/keyorder_2467_test.go, modelsdk/mpr/writer_recreate_keyorder_2467_test.go
cause: The encoder wrote a new element's keys in metamodel order and appended a property added to a stored element at the end; Studio Pro writes $ID, $Type, then the rest case-insensitively sorted.
insight: **Measure the ordering rule across versions before writing it**: the issue proposed ordinal order, but ordinal has 5 types out of place in Studio Pro's own output (`_Key` before `Caption`); case-insensitive has 0 exceptions in 34 596 / 43 998 / 44 003 objects of 10.24 / 11.12.6 / 11.14 projects. `mx convert --in-place` reproduces Studio Pro's rewrite headlessly, so 'units changed by mx convert' (9 before, 0 after on the same script) is the end-to-end measurement. A path that writes despite canon saying unchanged (the delete+insert recreate) must land the stored bytes, or sorting turns a no-op into a rewrite.
